title: Jamaican Chicken Keto Pilaf
description: A flavorful and spicy Jamaican-inspired dish made with chicken, cauliflower pilaf, and a hint of Caribbean seasoning. Perfect for a keto diet.
instructions: Rinse the chicken and pat it dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, mix together the jerk seasoning, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Rub the spice mixture all over the chicken, making sure to coat it evenly.
Heat the coconut oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until it's browned.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, pulse the cauliflower in a food processor until it resembles rice.
Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the cauliflower rice to the skillet and cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring frequently, until it's tender and lightly browned.
Fluff the cauliflower rice with a fork and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Once the chicken is done, let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing it thinly.
Serve the chicken on top of the cauliflower pilaf and garnish with chopped cilantro if desired.
